User Agreement and Privacy Policy of CL (Clegendary Launcher)

Version: 1.1.0 | Effective date: October 23, 2026

This document governs the terms of use of the "CL (Clegendary Launcher)" software (including CL:Cross and Windows Edition) and establishes the policy for processing technical data. By accepting this Agreement when launching the application, you confirm your consent to its provisions.

PART I. TERMS OF USE AND OPEN SOURCE (EULA)
1. Project Status and Age Restrictions

1.1. CL is free, non-commercial, open-source software developed by an independent community of enthusiasts.
1.2. You confirm that you have reached the age of digital consent under the laws of your country (16 years in most EU countries, 14 years in Ukraine), or have the permission of a parent or legal guardian to use this software.

2. Code Licensing (GNU GPLv3)

2.1. The logic and source code of the Launcher are licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPLv3). You are free to inspect, modify, and redistribute the source code.
2.2. The full text of the license is distributed with the software (LICENSE file), and the complete source code is available at:

Source Repository: https://github.com/WER-CORE/CL-OpenSource

2.3. Nothing in this document limits your rights granted under the GNU GPLv3 license regarding the source code.
3. Trademarks, Branding, and Third-Party APIs (Trademark Policy)

3.1. Under Section 7 of the GNU GPLv3 license ("Additional Terms"), the GPLv3 license DOES NOT extend to trademarks, brand names, or graphical brand assets.
3.2. The names "CL", "Clegendary Launcher", original logos, icons, and banners constitute the visual identity of the project creators.
3.3. Requirements for Forks (Derivative Builds):
If you create your own modification or fork of the launcher, you must:

Change the name of the program and completely replace the CL branding graphics with your own to avoid misleading users.
Use your own access credentials (Client IDs / API Keys) for Microsoft OAuth and CurseForge Core API services. Using the original CL project's keys in third-party builds is strictly prohibited.
4. Compatibility with Minecraft EULA and Mod Repositories

4.1. The Launcher is an independent third-party client and is NOT an official product of Mojang Studios or Microsoft Corporation. "Minecraft" is a registered trademark of Mojang Synergies AB.
4.2. The Launcher DOES NOT distribute game files. All game archives and libraries are downloaded directly and exclusively from official Mojang/Microsoft servers.
4.3. Authentication is handled via the official secure Microsoft Identity mechanism (OAuth 2.0). We encourage players to use a licensed copy of the game.
4.4. Access to modifications is provided via public APIs of CurseForge and Modrinth with mandatory author attribution and strict adherence to prohibitions on unauthorized re-hosting of files.

5. Limitation of Liability (Disclaimer)

5.1. The Launcher is provided on an "AS IS" basis, without warranties of any kind, in accordance with Sections 15 and 16 of the GNU GPLv3 license.
5.2. The developers are not liable for crashes caused by incompatible third-party modifications, account bans on game servers, or hardware failures. If the laws of your jurisdiction limit warranty disclaimers, liability is limited to the minimum extent permitted by law.

PART II. PRIVACY AND DATA PROTECTION POLICY (GDPR)
6. Data Controller, Full Anonymity, and Contacts

6.1. The Data Controller under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Ukrainian personal data protection legislation is the developer initiative group of the CL project (Clegendary Launcher Open Source Project).
6.2. Full Anonymity of Technical Data (Art. 11 and Recital 26 GDPR):
Bug reports and crash dumps are completely anonymous and contain no personal data, user identifiers, or network addresses. Because developers deliberately do not collect information that allows identifying a specific user, these technical logs are not subject to personal identification or selective erasure under Article 11 GDPR. All error logs are automatically and permanently deleted by the server after their retention period expires (up to 90 days).
6.3. Official communication channels for inquiries and requests:

Official Email: clsup125@gmail.com
GitHub Issues: https://github.com/WER-CORE/CL-OpenSource/issues
Discord: clegendary
7. Privacy by Design and Data Minimization

7.1. The Launcher DOES NOT collect your passwords, personal files, browsing history, or sensitive personal data.
7.2. All Microsoft authorization tokens, launcher settings, and local profiles are stored strictly on your device.

8. Legal Bases for Technical Data Processing

8.1. Application Updates:

Legal Basis: Article 6(1)(f) GDPR (Legitimate interests of the developer in ensuring software security and stability).
What is processed: To deliver update files, the web server temporarily records the client's IP address in system web server logs (log rotation up to 30 days). No profiling or identification of the user is performed.
8.2. Crash Reports (Sentry):
Legal Basis: Article 6(1)(a) GDPR (Voluntary prior consent — OPT-IN).
Conditions: Automatic crash reporting is DISABLED by default. It is activated exclusively by your explicit choice in the launcher settings.
What is transmitted: Technical .NET error stack trace, OS version, and launcher version. Data Scrubbing mechanisms automatically sanitize local system usernames from file paths (sendDefaultPii = false).
Cross-border Transfers: Sentry (Functional Software, Inc., USA) processes technical reports based on EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (DPF) certification and Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC). Report retention period is up to 90 days.
9. Your Rights and Changes to the Agreement

9.1. You have the right to withdraw your consent to crash report submission at any time by unchecking the option in the "Settings" section of the launcher.
9.2. In case of material changes to this document, users will be notified inside the application interface with the new document version indicated. An archive of previous revisions is maintained in the project repository.
